sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: Cozy Health Limited (registration number 8215009), Igwe Street, Rumuodara, Rivers State, Nigeria, operates Cozy Health and determines the operation of its consumer-controlled wellbeing service. This policy covers the app, website and optional individual provider connections. Contact us for privacy questions, access, correction, export, deletion or complaints.

Email Team@cozyhealth.org. Requests enter a shared team queue and are assigned to an available team member. Responses are generally faster between 8am and 5pm West Africa Time (WAT, UTC+1). These are not guaranteed operating hours or a response-time promise; the inbox is not continuously monitored.

sections.heading: Information we process
paragraphs: We process account details and credentials; mood and wellbeing entries; journals and associated recordings where used; assessment responses and scores; provider connections, sharing choices and messages; community contributions; and security and access records. Student applicants may submit institution and enrolment evidence. Emergency-contact setup collects the contact details needed for the chosen contact method.
Some information is stored in an account-specific local cache for offline use and synchronized with our service. Removing the app is not the same as deleting your account.

sections.heading: Why we process information
paragraphs: We use information to provide requested features, maintain accounts, score assessments, enable chosen provider sharing, protect the service and respond to support requests. We rely on contract where applicable for necessary account/service administration, legitimate interests for proportionate security, fraud prevention and support, and legal obligations where processing is required by law. You may object to legitimate-interest processing under applicable law.

Consent-based processing of health and wellbeing information requires a separate explicit choice. Optional analytics, diagnostics and marketing have independent choices. Accepting the Terms or reading this policy does not supply health-data consent. Consent can be withdrawn without changing the lawfulness of earlier processing.

Assessment scoring supports self-reflection and tracking; it does not make a diagnosis, determine insurance/employment eligibility or replace professional judgment. We do not sell personal information, share it for cross-context behavioural advertising, or use private health content for targeted advertising.

sections.heading: Provider sharing is your choice
paragraphs: A linked provider can see your first name, identifier, sharing choices and assigned-resource status. Optional categories start off: mood entries, journal summaries, assessment results and provider notes. Journal summaries include metadata such as titles, type, word count and dates. Separately, after enabling journal sharing, you can preview and explicitly confirm a written entry snapshot containing its title and body for that provider. A written-entry share does not automatically share other entries, later edits, recordings or transcripts. Specific assessment-result sharing also requires the applicable permission.

Separately, after enabling journal sharing, you can preview and explicitly confirm a voice-journal share with your connected provider. This allows online playback of that selected recording while the connection, journal permission and individual share remain active. It does not share other recordings or create a transcript. Revoking access stops subsequent authorized playback; it cannot erase audio already received or copied by the provider.

Providers may view or export authorized information. You can turn categories off or disconnect in My Provider. New requests respect changes; already viewed, copied or downloaded information cannot be recalled. Reconnecting starts with optional categories off.

sections.heading: Optional analytics and diagnostics
paragraphs: PostHog supports optional usage analytics when configured and only after opt-in. Selected events may measure participating users? general app activity, signup/onboarding progress, general feature use, return visits, app version and platform. Analytics excludes journal text, chat messages, mood values, assessment responses/results, crisis activity, emergency contacts and student evidence. Session recording and automatic interaction capture stay off. Analytics can be disabled in Privacy settings.

Sentry supports optional technical diagnostics when configured and crash-reporting consent is enabled. Filtering is designed to exclude private content and credentials. Firebase Cloud Messaging supports push notifications when configured, permission is granted and notifications are enabled. Delivery also depends on the device, operating system and network. Firebase is not our usage-analytics provider.

sections.heading: Vendors and transfers
paragraphs: Railway hosts the application, databases and private files. The current application/database and storage deployments are in the western United States. Brevo provides transactional email. Formspree processes website waitlist submissions. Cloudflare provides domain DNS; it is not currently the reverse proxy for application/API traffic. Development and source-code tools do not need your private journal or assessment content.

Apple or Google receive sign-in information if you choose their sign-in options. Purchase processing begins only when store billing is activated. PostHog and Sentry serve the separate optional purposes described above when configured and enabled.

Information may be processed outside Nigeria and your home country. Where transfer restrictions apply, the relevant transfer must have a lawful mechanism and necessary safeguards, such as approved contractual clauses where applicable. Contact Team@cozyhealth.org for details of the safeguards applicable to your information. This notice does not itself establish a missing vendor agreement or permit a restricted transfer.

sections.heading: Retention and deletion
paragraphs: We retain active account and wellbeing information while the account is active, unless you delete an item earlier or a shorter feature-specific period applies. Confirmed account deletion removes the active account and related records covered by the deletion process. Remaining account files and recoverable backup copies must be removed or expire within 30 days, except for a documented legal obligation or hold. Restricted backups are for recovery and must not reintroduce deleted accounts into ordinary service.

Routine security and access records have a two-year limit. Raw student-verification evidence becomes inaccessible immediately on approval or rejection and is deleted immediately; failed physical deletion is retained only for restricted cleanup retry. Pending evidence expires 14 days after submission and is removed through the cleanup process. The eligibility decision and expiry may remain while needed to administer the account. Inactive waitlist entries are removed after 12 months without renewed interest. We retain only the minimum records needed for a documented legal obligation, dispute or incident and review each exception when it ends.

Provider-held copies are controlled by the provider and cannot be recalled by deleting your Cozy Health account. Unlinking a provider is not account deletion. Visit cozyhealth.org/support to request deletion without the app. Store subscriptions, when available, must be cancelled through the store separately.

sections.heading: Young people
paragraphs: Cozy Health is intended for people aged 13 and older. Store age restrictions and regional availability apply to distribution. Cozy does not operate a custom date-of-birth or guardian-authorization workflow. Store age ratings are not proof of identity or legal eligibility for every feature. Additional local age and consent conditions may apply.

Ordinary health-data and provider-sharing choices remain separate. An age rating or a provider connection does not give another person access to private journals, messages or records. Contact Team@cozyhealth.org about eligibility, privacy or an account concern.

sections.heading: Your choices and complaints
paragraphs: You can change optional analytics, diagnostics, marketing and provider-sharing choices independently. Depending on applicable law, you may request access, correction, portability, deletion or restriction; object to certain processing; and withdraw consent. Contact Team@cozyhealth.org. We use proportionate identity/authority checks; do not send passwords, full journals or government ID with an initial request.

We handle requests within applicable legal deadlines and explain any lawful exception or permitted extension. Support availability does not extend statutory deadlines. You may complain to the Nigeria Data Protection Commission at ndpc.gov.ng, or the competent authority where you live. Local consumer and privacy protections remain available.

Withdrawal of health-data consent stops future consent-based processing and may make related features unavailable. It does not undo earlier lawful processing or retrieve provider-held copies. Emergency resources remain accessible.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: Each published policy has an identified version and permanent link. We communicate material changes as required and obtain a fresh choice where necessary for new consent-based purposes. Contact the company at the postal address above or Team@cozyhealth.org.

sections.heading: Professional use
paragraphs: These Terms govern individual providers using the dashboard supplied by Cozy Health Limited (registration number 8215009), Igwe Street, Rumuodara, Rivers State, Nigeria. Provide accurate identity, practice and professional-licence information, maintain authorization to practise where applicable and use your own account. Provider access is for adults authorized to perform the professional role. A verification indicator is not a clinical endorsement.

This launch serves consumer-controlled individual accounts and optional individual provider connections. It is not offered under these Terms as an organization-managed clinical record or outsourced patient-management service.

sections.heading: Authorized patient relationships
paragraphs: Access only patients with whom you have an authorized active connection, for the disclosed care-support purpose. Patient links do not enable every category: respect separate permissions, selected assessment-result grants and revocation. Do not bypass restrictions or access another provider’s patients.

sections.heading: Clinical responsibility and service boundaries
paragraphs: The dashboard supports selected wellbeing records, provider messages, notes, assigned resources and authorized reports. It is not an emergency service, diagnostic engine or replacement for clinical judgment. You remain responsible for professional duties and explaining your availability and response arrangements to patients.

sections.heading: Data you may access
paragraphs: Patient identity/link status and assignment progress may remain visible while connected. Optional sharing covers mood entries, journal summaries, assessment results and provider notes as authorized. A separate, explicitly confirmed written-entry share can include a snapshot of its title and body. This does not automatically include later edits, recordings, transcripts or other entries. Titles and summaries can also be sensitive.

A patient can separately preview and explicitly confirm a voice-journal share. You may play that selected recording online only while the connection, journal permission and individual share remain active. A written-entry share does not itself include audio, and voice sharing does not create a transcript. Respect withdrawal and the restrictions on retained copies described below.

sections.heading: Security and downloaded copies
paragraphs: Protect credentials, devices and exported files. Do not share accounts, scrape data, repurpose it for advertising or redistribute it without authorization. Apply minimum necessary access and report suspected compromise to Team@cozyhealth.org.

Revocation stops subsequent authorized access; it cannot recall data you already viewed, copied or downloaded. You are responsible for lawful handling of those copies, retention obligations and secure disposal. Do not rely on this portal as your only legally required clinical record.

sections.heading: Patient rights and practice responsibilities
paragraphs: Maintain your practice’s own privacy notices and permissions. Coordinate rights requests with Team@cozyhealth.org. Where patients are minors, verify the authority and permissions applicable to the service you provide. Platform policy acceptance does not replace professional consent requirements.

An age rating or provider connection does not automatically give another person access to private journals, messages or professional records. Respect the young person’s confidentiality and applicable rights.

sections.heading: Agreements, fees and termination
paragraphs: Cozy Health determines operation of its consumer platform; you determine your independent professional purposes and obligations for information you lawfully receive. Actual roles depend on the arrangement and law, not merely labels. Cooperate on rights requests, incidents and lawful restrictions.

Do not start organization-managed clinic processing or processing requiring a processor agreement, business associate agreement or other regulated arrangement until the requirements and infrastructure are approved in writing and necessary agreements are signed. These Terms are not such an agreement or certification of HIPAA, GDPR or NDPA compliance.

Consumer subscriptions do not establish provider fees. These Terms create no provider charge; any future fee requires separately disclosed acceptance. We may restrict unsafe/unauthorized access and investigate reports. On termination, stop using the portal and handle retained copies lawfully. Submit complaints or appeals to Team@cozyhealth.org.

sections.heading: Acceptance and changes
paragraphs: Acceptance is recorded against the displayed version and individual provider account. Material required changes need fresh review where necessary. Nigerian law governs to the extent permitted by applicable law, without removing mandatory protections or competent-court rights elsewhere. Nothing excludes liability or remedies that cannot lawfully be excluded.

Email Team@cozyhealth.org. Requests enter a shared team queue and are assigned to an available team member. Responses are generally faster between 8am and 5pm West Africa Time (WAT, UTC+1). These are not guaranteed operating hours or a response-time promise; the inbox is not continuously monitored.

This notice covers providers and patient information handled through optional individual connections. It supplements cozyhealth.org/privacy and does not replace your practice’s own patient notice.

sections.heading: Provider and practice information
paragraphs: We process your name, email, practice/professional details, licence and verification information where supplied, timezone, credentials, session information and support communications. Passwords are hashed rather than stored as readable passwords.

sections.heading: Patient workflows
paragraphs: We process patient links and sharing choices, assigned-resource status, provider notes, direct provider messages, authorized assessment results and generated reports. Access is scoped to the active relationship and relevant permissions. Journal summaries exclude full text. A separately confirmed written-entry share can expose its title and body snapshot to the chosen provider; it does not include recordings or transcripts.

A patient can separately preview and explicitly confirm sharing a selected voice-journal recording for online playback. Access requires an active connection, journal-sharing permission and an active individual share. It does not include other recordings or transcripts. Withdrawal prevents subsequent authorized playback but cannot recall bytes already received or copied.

sections.heading: Access records and purposes
paragraphs: Access records may include actor and resource identifiers, actions, timestamps, request IP and user-agent information. Infrastructure proxies can affect the recorded IP. These records support security, authorization, accountability and investigation; they are not a promise of continuous clinical monitoring.

sections.heading: Recipients and responsibilities
paragraphs: Patient information is made available to authorized linked providers and appropriately authorized staff, with vendors handling what is needed to run and secure the service. Providers remain responsible for their independent professional records, downloaded copies, onward disclosures and notices. Actual legal roles depend on the arrangement and law.

We rely on contract where applicable for the requested provider service, legitimate interests for proportionate security, fraud prevention and accountability, and legal obligations where required. Consent-based health processing/sharing requires separate permission. Accepting this notice is not health consent, treatment consent or a processor agreement.

Railway hosts the app/database and private files in the western United States; Brevo supports transactional email. Cloudflare supplies DNS rather than proxying application/API traffic. Formspree handles the public waitlist, not patient intake. Restricted international transfers require an applicable lawful mechanism and safeguards; ask Team@cozyhealth.org for details. We do not sell patient information or share it for cross-context behavioural advertising.

This launch does not offer organization-managed clinic processing. Assess actual roles and execute any required regulated-data agreements before expanding the model. This notice does not establish a missing agreement or claim universal regulatory compliance.

sections.heading: Analytics and diagnostics
paragraphs: Patient-data dashboard screens are not instrumented with PostHog. Optional consumer analytics excludes patient content, assessment results, crisis activity and provider messages. Any configured technical diagnostics must exclude patient content and credentials.

sections.heading: Patient controls and retention
paragraphs: Patients can change optional sharing or revoke a connection. Subsequent access respects the change; already downloaded copies cannot be recalled. Reconnection starts with optional categories off. Unlinking and account deletion are different actions.

Provider account information is kept while active and needed to operate the service. Closure/verified rights requests trigger applicable deletion or restriction. Routine security/access records have a two-year limit, and remaining account files/backups a 30-day deletion/expiry limit after account deletion, subject to documented legal obligations or holds. Patient information follows the consumer retention policy. Providers must apply their own lawful schedules to independent professional records and explain those to individuals.

sections.heading: Rights, requests and security
paragraphs: Contact Team@cozyhealth.org for access, correction, deletion or privacy complaints. We verify identity and authority proportionately and coordinate requests involving practice records. Applicable rights and exceptions depend on the role and relevant law. Report suspected misuse promptly and avoid including patient health content in an initial support email.

We respond within applicable legal deadlines and explain any lawful exception or permitted extension. You may complain to the Nigeria Data Protection Commission at ndpc.gov.ng or the competent authority where you live. Material changes are versioned and communicated as required.
